res: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
cimm: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.d: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 ft..
For every 5 ft. the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.d: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: fire, poison — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.
Сопротивление урону: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Иммунитет к состояниям: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious — заклинания/эффекты с такими состояниями не подействуют.
Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект / Харизму (-2) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Мультиатака — наносит несколько ударов за ход. Эффекты обездвиживания/оглушения особенно ценны против него.
